
 Usage: root dataset [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Manage your datasets: edit, withdraw, resubmit, diff, open

   Options
  --help          Show this message and exit.

   Commands
  open      Open a dataset in the browser.
  diff      Show metadata diff between two versions.
  edit      Edit metadata on a submission.
  withdraw  Withdraw a pending_curation submission.
  resubmit  Resubmit a rejected dataset back to the curation queue.
